_meta.description: OGA per-work composition dating (CTS-URN -> ISO date + date-label), resolved to a cog work slug with a derived signed century + era. build_registry.py applies these as century/era tags: it FILLS a missing tag and flags (never overwrites) a disagreement; see data/oga_dating_report.json for the applied audit.
_meta.citation: Giuseppe G. A. Celano. 2024. Opera Graeca Adnotata (v0.2.0). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14206061
_meta.century_derivation: signed century of the midpoint year of formatted_work_date (ISO 8601 range; em-dash = BCE), date_label used as the fallback
_meta.tagging_policy: fill gaps, never clobber; record both readings and flag a per-work disagreement (Multi-Source Data)

tlg0010.tlg018.title: Areopagiticus

tlg0010.tlg018.date_source: (2000). Isocrates I. New York, USA: University of Texas Press
tlg0010.tlg018.comment: This speech is considered to have been composed around the time of the Social War (357-355 BC), fought between Athens and some of her former naval allies.

tlg0010.tlg019.title: Antidosis

tlg0010.tlg019.date_source: (2000). Isocrates I. New York, USA: University of Texas Press

tlg0010.tlg020.date_source: (2000). Isocrates I. New York, USA: University of Texas Press
tlg0010.tlg020.comment: This speech was addressed in support of the Macedonian King Philip II, father of Alexander the Great.

tlg0010.tlg021.title: Panathenaicus

tlg0028.tlg006.title: On the Choreutes
tlg0028.tlg006.author: Antiphon
tlg0028.tlg006.date_source: 1998). Antiphon and Andocides. New York, USA: University of Texas Press
tlg0028.tlg006.comment: Council. According to Gagarin and MacDowell, this year the Choregus' tribe was assigned the first Prytany, which at the time was always 37 days long. He tells us he served 35 of these days (all but two) and earlier (6.44) that he served for 20 days of Metageitnion (the second month).We can thus calculate that the new Council began its service that year on the 16th day of Hekatombaion (the ®rst month), and the evidence of inscriptions informs us that this happened in 419/8 bc and in no other year near this.
